summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by China Yuchai International Ltd., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, announcing a cash dividend of US$0.87 per ordinary share declared by its board for FY2025. The dividend will be paid on July 28, 2026 to shareholders of record on July 17, 2026. There are no special-situation features such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return plan beyond routine dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, categorically not a special situation.
